== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ジェローン・ウェッブ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。反乱軍のリーダーとともに戦闘する場合、相手の戦闘運命数の合計から１を引く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ラルティア人。ラルティアが征服された後、同星の地下組織に潜伏し、スパイとして暗躍していた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Jeroen Webb.

'''Lore''' — A Ralltiirian. After Ralltiir was conquered, he hid in that planet's underground organization and secretly worked as a spy.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. When in battle with a Rebel leader, subtract 1 from the opponent's total battle destiny.

One asterisk precedes the title. Lore calls him a Ralltiirian who hid and worked as a spy. Game text adds 2 to 宇宙船 power, matching original printed “starship” rather than errata “anything”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-jeroenwebb-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Jeroen Webb]].</ref>
